project.name: Eclipse Cargo Tracker
project.description: Jakarta EE sample application demonstrating Domain-Driven Design for tracking shipping cargo. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README: Cargo Tracker is a Jakarta EE sample application demonstrating Domain-Driven Design for shipping cargo.

tour.title: Cargo Aggregate
tour.description: The core aggregate root: Cargo identified by TrackingId, with routing and delivery state.

tour.title: Routing Model
tour.description: RouteSpecification states what route is desired; Itinerary and Legs describe the actual planned route.

tour.title: Locations and Voyages
tour.description: Supporting entities: Locations and Voyages that cargo moves through.

tour.title: Handling Events
tour.description: HandlingEvents record what happens to cargo and drive delivery updates.

tour.title: Repositories and Services (Domain)
tour.description: Domain-defined interfaces for persistence and routing, implemented in infrastructure.

tour.title: Application Services
tour.description: Use-case orchestration for booking, handling and inspection.

tour.title: Persistence and Messaging
tour.description: JPA repositories and JMS-based event publishing implement the infrastructure layer.

tour.title: External Routing
tour.description: ExternalRoutingService calls the separate Pathfinder service for candidate itineraries.

tour.title: Booking Interface
tour.description: Web UI, facade and DTO assemblers expose booking to users.

tour.title: Handling and Tracking Interfaces
tour.description: Handling events arrive through REST, files and mobile; tracking is shown via web and websockets.
